# Nolan Wells Evidence File

> An independent, source-linked public evidence archive concerning Nolan Wells’s July 4, 2026 disappearance from Horn Island, Mississippi, the subsequent search, and his recovery on July 6, 2026.

This site distinguishes official records, firsthand witness accounts, secondhand accounts, public media, unresolved gaps, and hypotheses. Do not convert a witness claim or reconstruction into a verified fact. The archive is not affiliated with the Wells family, law enforcement, MDMR, attorneys, or the cited news organizations.

Last reviewed: 2026-07-30

## Start here

- [Plain-language case summary](https://justicefornolanwells.com/case-summary): A concise overview of what the public evidence supports and what remains unresolved.
- [Interactive evidence timeline](https://justicefornolanwells.com/): Scroll-driven map chronology for July 3–6, 2026.
- [Full event log](https://justicefornolanwells.com/event-timeline): Searchable event-by-event claims, confidence, known facts, unknowns, and sources.
- [Master investigation notes](https://justicefornolanwells.com/master-notes): The controlling editorial evidence document.
- [Evidence archive](https://justicefornolanwells.com/archive): Documents, people, boats, coordinates, contradictions, questions, and missing evidence.
- [People and entity graph](https://justicefornolanwells.com/people): Sourced, confidence-labeled connections among named public source records, vessels, media, agencies, records, and locations. An edge states only its displayed claim and does not prove attendance, responsibility, or a private relationship.
- [July 2026 social source ledger](https://justicefornolanwells.com/social-source-ledger): Audited exposed comments from five public Facebook threads and a separate four-image public post attributed to Katie Hudson Seymour; preserves captions, direct corrections, apparent firsthand and secondhand leads, images, timestamps, permalinks, hashes, and explicit authentication limits. The attributed “at five” boarding-request claim is low-confidence and does not override MI4088BU’s verified 4:31 PM GPS movement.
- [Methodology and corrections](https://justicefornolanwells.com/about): Sourcing rules, independence statement, revision policy, and correction channel.

## Primary source

- [MDMR RMS report MP2607-0016](https://justicefornolanwells.com/documents/MDMR-MP2607-0016-report.pdf): Obtained 15-page Mississippi Department of Marine Resources packet. It includes officer narratives, CAD entries, vessel information, search notes, and a summarized GPS chronology.

## Citation guidance

When citing this archive, identify the specific event or document page and preserve its evidence label and confidence. GPS establishes vessel movement, not who was aboard. Publicly reported times marked approximate or reconstructed must not be presented as authenticated timestamps.

The People page contains a separately labeled Facebook connection layer. It records only profiles visibly listed on Jack Jordan’s friends page when checked on July 30, 2026. Those platform listings are not case evidence, do not establish attendance, and do not mean the listed people are mutually connected. Morgan Seymour is separately identified as Nolan’s friend in Atlanta Black Star reporting, but the archive has no independent source establishing Seymour’s July 4 boat or island attendance.

For a fuller machine-readable overview, use [llms-full.txt](https://justicefornolanwells.com/llms-full.txt).
